title: Audit‑ready questionnaire synthesis and evidence chronicle
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Customers repeatedly ask for packaged evidence for audits (DPA clauses, residency proofs, retention settings) and expect a single downloadable artifact that maps controls to artifacts. Current intake is manual (tickets + ad hoc exports) and takes customer success hours.

Goal: Build an intake + synthesis flow that: (1) collects questionnaire responses or uploaded auditor forms, (2) automatically assembles residency/retention artifacts (config snapshots, storage location manifests, retention policy settings), (3) composes a signed audit bundle (PDF + manifest + links to logs) with provenance and timestamps, and (4) exposes an API used by Console and CS.

High‑level requirements:
- Intake: UI + API to accept questionnaire submissions, select DPA version, and attach customer-specific requirements. Support uploading third‑party auditor forms.
- Residency snapshot: Query control plane to produce a per-customer residency matrix (regions, storage classes, backups, replicas) as of snapshot time. Include cloud region identifiers and dataset residency tags.
- Retention evidence: Export effective retention settings (object lifecycle, DB TTLs, logs retention) and the policy change history for requested timeframe.
- Signed bundle: Generate an export package containing a human‑readable report, a machine manifest (CSV/JSON), links to immutable audit logs, and a signed integrity stamp (GPG/KMS).
- Automation rules: Allow scheduling of periodic snapshot exports and on‑demand generation. Support canary/preview mode for internal review.
- Mapping: Each item in the bundle must map back to a control (SOC2/ISO/contract DPA clause) so customers can find source evidence quickly.
- CS workflow: Include a short runbook for CS to review and approve bundles before delivery; provide an opt‑in automated delivery to customer SFTP/console access.

Acceptance criteria:
- End‑to‑end flow demonstrated in staging: intake -> snapshot -> bundle export -> signed download.
- Residency snapshot covers all storage types (object, block, DB), lists regions for each data type, and includes timestamps.
- Retention export shows last 12 months of policy changes and the effective policy at snapshot.
- Generated bundle includes mapping to control IDs and audit log links that persist for at least 90 days in the console.
- API documented (OpenAPI spec) and Console has a minimal ‘Export Evidence’ button for customer success.

Design tradeoffs discussed:
- Live query vs. cached snapshot: live queries ensure freshness but risk cross‑service timeouts for large customers. We will implement a hybrid: a fast cached manifest updated by a background snapshot job plus an optional live verification step when requested.
- Signed bundle method: use KMS signing (preferred for enterprise key management) with fallback to internal GPG for hosted. Evaluate HSM integration for Private deployments.
- Scope: initial rollout will exclude archived/air‑gapped on‑prem exports; those will be covered in follow‑up with Private deployment team.

Dependencies:
- ENG-38910 (residency metadata API enhancements)
- ENG-40224 (retention-history audit logs)
- DES-204 (bundle report template + PDF layout)
- PM-45200 (DPA versioning catalog)

Customer impact: "high"

Security_review_required: "true"
